**What happens if I miss a payment?**

If any payment is 10 days late, the Lender may charge a late fee of $25.

**Can I pay back the loan early?**

Yes, you have the right to pay back the loan in full or make additional payments at any time without penalty.

**What happens if I default on the loan?**

If you default on the loan, the Lender may declare all sums due under this Agreement immediately due and payable.
